$note: Studio memory, kept by the Learning Keeper. status: candidate (advisory) | rule (must follow) | retired. Edit freely: set status 'rule' to approve (approved_by: human) or 'retired' to drop.

lessons.title: Encode shot geography and scale before rendering
lessons.problem: Keyframes often lose the designed camera position, lens-specific scale, screen direction, or subject orientation, producing a plausible image that tells the wrong beat.
lessons.cause: The prompt describes scene elements without locking their spatial relationship to the camera and the intended frame hierarchy.
lessons.prevention: State the camera position, lens, framing scale, subject distance, screen direction, and required dominant visual subject before listing atmosphere or details.
lessons.check: Verify camera side, shot size, subject scale, eyeline direction, and story focus match the board.

lessons.title: Make the opening keyframe visibly contain the scripted action
lessons.problem: Keyframes omit the physical cue that establishes the next action, such as rescue contact, a spray of water, a passed canteen, or a plate under a character's gaze.
lessons.cause: Prompts name the dramatic beat but do not specify the visible body-object relationship or transitional pose needed for animation.
lessons.prevention: Describe the exact opening-phase pose, contact, prop position, and visible physical effect that makes the imminent action readable in one frame.
lessons.check: Confirm the required action cue, contact point, prop, and direction of movement are visibly readable.

lessons.title: Constrain 1973 Egyptian military identifiers
lessons.problem: Generated commandos acquire modern tactical rigs, headgear, malformed AKMs, or incorrect rank insignia instead of the production's approved period military appearance.
lessons.cause: Models default to generic contemporary military equipment and decorative insignia unless each constrained identifier is explicitly visualized.
lessons.prevention: Specify bare heads, approved canvas webbing, coherent period AKM construction, and the exact rank device count and shape for every visible commando.
lessons.check: Inspect headgear, webbing closures, weapon construction, and every visible rank device for approved period details.

lessons.title: Protect the clean-and-pressed costume state
lessons.problem: Characters designated clean arrive with salt, dust, mottling, stains, or excessive rumpling that changes continuity and characterization.
lessons.cause: Desert and airfield context biases generation toward weathered uniforms despite the specified wear state.
lessons.prevention: Explicitly render designated uniforms and webbing clean, evenly sand-khaki, recently pressed, and free of dust or salt while retaining only natural movement folds.
lessons.check: Verify no conspicuous dust, salt, stains, mottling, or heavy rumpling appears on clean-designated wardrobe.

lessons.title: Use period retail dressing without modern packaging
lessons.problem: Village grocery and domestic-shop backgrounds contain modern plastic bottles, bright packaging, labels, or pseudo-text that break the period setting.
lessons.cause: Unconstrained product generation defaults to contemporary packaged merchandise and text-like graphics.
lessons.prevention: Dress 1973 Egyptian retail shelves only with unlabeled glass bottles, plain tins, paper packets, cloth sacks, simple jars, and worn subdued signage.
lessons.check: Reject modern plastic, bright branded packaging, readable labels, and pseudo-text in visible shop goods.

lessons.title: Use character anchors when a face is visible
lessons.problem: A recurring character's facial structure, tattoo, or profile drifts from the approved identity when the face is visible in a new angle.
lessons.cause: Prompt-only identity descriptions do not reliably preserve specific facial anchors across poses and lighting conditions.
lessons.prevention: Use the approved character reference and explicitly retain the defining facial anchors; choose a rearward angle when the beat does not require a visible face.
lessons.check: Compare visible facial structure, marks, and profile against the approved character reference.

lessons.title: Specify exact aircraft count in formations
lessons.problem: Generated aerial formations can omit required vehicles, weakening the designed scale and formation read.
lessons.cause: The generation brief did not make the exact aircraft count a visually verifiable formation constraint.
lessons.prevention: State the exact number, type, relative altitude, spacing, and silhouette treatment of every aircraft in the visible formation.
lessons.check: Count every visible aircraft and verify each matches the required type, spacing, and scale.

lessons.title: Render RPG-7 inserts with complete period-defining geometry
lessons.problem: RPG-7s lose their recognizable loaded-round, optic, and launcher geometry in close prop shots.
lessons.cause: Weapon prompts omitted the distinctive PG-7V warhead, side-mounted PGO-7 optic, and complete launcher construction.
lessons.prevention: Specify an accurate loaded RPG-7 with wooden heat shields, rear venturi, pistol grips, side-mounted PGO-7 optic, and a broad PG-7V warhead inserted through the muzzle.
lessons.check: Verify the PG-7V warhead, PGO-7 side optic, wooden shields, grips, and venturi are all recognizable.

lessons.title: Motivate bare-bulb interiors with one practical source
lessons.problem: Barracks interiors gain extra visible bulbs or incoherent facial illumination despite a single-bulb lighting design.
lessons.cause: The practical source count and its intended key direction were not constrained before rendering.
lessons.prevention: Show only one bare incandescent practical and explicitly place its warm key direction, falloff, and required facial shadow or mouth visibility.
lessons.check: Verify exactly one visible practical bulb and facial lighting consistent with its position.

lessons.title: Use verified Arabic handwriting for readable text inserts
lessons.problem: Macro shots of Arabic letters produce pseudo-Arabic with broken connections, malformed marks, and illegible words.
lessons.cause: Image generation was asked to synthesize Arabic text rather than reproduce vetted fluent handwriting.
lessons.prevention: Use a vetted fluent-writer Arabic passage as the visible text reference and preserve its right-to-left connected handwriting in the insert.
lessons.check: Inspect every visible word for natural right-to-left connections, marks, and legibility.

lessons.title: Direct the opening performance state explicitly
lessons.problem: Generated performers default to alert, neutral, or minimally expressive faces when the shot requires a specific emotional state or intelligible vocal effort.
lessons.cause: Expression, eyelid state, gaze target, and mouth shape were under-specified relative to the intended opening performance beat.
lessons.prevention: State the exact eyelid, brow, gaze, mouth shape, facial tension, and emotional state required at the opening moment; explicitly forbid camera acknowledgement.
lessons.check: Verify expression, gaze, and mouth visibly convey the scripted opening emotional or speaking state.

lessons.title: Specify Egyptian commando ensemble casting
lessons.problem: Wide military ensembles default to fair European-looking soldiers rather than credible Egyptian commandos.
lessons.cause: The visible group’s Egyptian casting and grooming variation were not explicitly constrained before rendering.
lessons.prevention: Specify every clearly visible commando as an Egyptian man with varied authentic Egyptian features, short black military hair, and no European-looking foreground casting.
lessons.check: Verify all clearly visible commandos read as Egyptian men with short black hair.

lessons.title: Maintain natural adult head-to-body proportions in portrait keyframes
lessons.problem: Close and medium-close portraits can render oversized heads and undersized shoulders, weakening realism and actor interaction.
lessons.cause: Portrait-oriented generation tends to favor facial scale, especially when more than one character shares a tightly framed shot.
lessons.prevention: Specify natural adult proportions: each visible man has shoulders approximately 2.5–3 head widths across, with anatomically proportionate neck, torso, and head scale.
lessons.check: Verify every visible adult has believable head, neck, shoulder, and upper-torso proportions.

lessons.title: Render red-filtered flashlight spill as a localized practical source
lessons.problem: Night keyframes omit the required red-filtered flashlight contribution and default to uniform cool moonlight.
lessons.cause: Without an explicit source direction and affected surfaces, the model treats colored tactical illumination as optional atmosphere rather than motivated light.
lessons.prevention: Place a subtle red-filtered flashlight just off-frame and specify its localized spill across the near face, mouth, neck, and adjacent uniform, balanced by blue moonlit shadows.
lessons.check: Verify localized red spill shapes the designated subject while surrounding shadows remain cool and dark.

lessons.title: Stage salt-marsh crossings at visibly shallow depth
lessons.problem: Salt-marsh shots can render water as ankle-deep sheets or turn a shallow crossing into implausibly deep water around the soldier and weapon.
lessons.cause: The prompt did not make the mid-shin immersion, salt-crust terrain, and equipment clearance visually explicit.
lessons.prevention: For salt-marsh crossings, require every standing soldier visibly mid-shin in brine over fractured white salt crust and black mud, with carried equipment held above the water unless the scripted action states otherwise.
lessons.check: Verify standing soldiers are immersed between ankle and knee, with salt crust and black mud visible; no gear touches brine.

lessons.title: Render marsh mud as cohesive broken clumps
lessons.problem: Macro wet-mud details can form repeated long cords or tentacles beneath boots, creating obvious generated-detail artifacts.
lessons.cause: Mud separation was unspecified at macro scale, allowing uniform stretched tendrils instead of heavy cohesive material.
lessons.prevention: Describe boot-lift mud as one heavy irregular black clump with a few short uneven strands, falling droplets, clean boot separation, and fractured salt crust around the contact point.
lessons.check: Verify mud forms irregular cohesive clumps, not repeated long cords, roots, tentacles, or melted strands.

lessons.title: Specify closed Malyutka transport cases as compact briefcases
lessons.problem: A 9M14 Malyutka transport prop can become an oversized generic missile assembly instead of a closed suitcase launcher.
lessons.cause: The transport-state silhouette and compact scale were not constrained clearly enough.
lessons.prevention: When the Malyutka is carried closed, specify a small closed fibreglass case about the size of a large briefcase, carried above water, with no missile, tube, or hardware mounted externally.
lessons.check: Verify the prop reads as a compact closed carrying case, not a missile, launcher tube, or oversized weapon assembly.

lessons.title: Match faces to the scene's motivated illumination
lessons.problem: Faces can appear warm, bright, or front-filled against otherwise dark cool moonlit scenes, breaking integration with the environment.
lessons.cause: Portrait and character prompts prioritized facial readability without specifying that skin exposure, color, shadow, and grain must share the scene lighting.
lessons.prevention: Light faces and exposed skin only with the scene's stated motivated source, matching its color temperature, exposure, shadow direction, wet highlights, and film grain; forbid warm frontal fill when the scene is moonlit.
lessons.check: Verify face, neck, and clothing share the environment's color, exposure, shadow direction, and source motivation.

lessons.title: Constrain limb count and grip contacts in strenuous action
lessons.problem: Complex overhead weapon actions can generate extra arms or detached hands, especially during falls and splashes.
lessons.cause: The action description did not explicitly constrain limb count, limb origin, and each hand's contact with the prop.
lessons.prevention: For complex action poses, state exactly two arms originating at the shoulders and identify both hands' continuous natural grip points on the prop throughout the movement.
lessons.check: Verify exactly two anatomically connected arms and two hands, with both grips physically continuous and plausible.

lessons.title: Light red aircraft cabins exclusively from the red practical
lessons.problem: Aircraft-cabin keyframes repeatedly introduce neutral or amber frontal illumination, weakening the intended dim red practical source, hard side/rim treatment, and deep shadow.
lessons.cause: The cabin look is not sufficiently constrained as a sole motivated source; the successful edits explicitly removed neutral key light and converted the visible practical to a subdued red cabin lamp.
lessons.prevention: Specify one subdued red electric cabin practical as the only key, placing its hard red side or rim direction and requiring the opposite facial half to fall into deep shadow.
lessons.check: Verify the practical reads red and no neutral, amber, or frontal fill illuminates faces or uniforms.

lessons.title: Specify functional cockpit control inserts and flight gloves
lessons.problem: Cockpit detail inserts substitute generic gauges or modern-looking gloves for the scripted period radio panel and full-finger flight equipment.
lessons.cause: The control context and handwear are under-specified, allowing models to default to generic avionics, readable gibberish displays, and tactical gloves.
lessons.prevention: For cockpit hand inserts, name the exact period analog control unit, require no readable display text, and specify a full-finger dark leather flying glove.
lessons.check: Verify the hand wears a full-finger leather flight glove and operates the specified analog panel rather than generic gauges or digital text.

lessons.title: Build face-model anchors as neutral, specification-faithful training portraits
lessons.problem: Actor anchors are accepted despite inconsistent age, facial geometry, eye color, grooming, eyebrow details, gaze, head angle, and portrait illumination, reducing their reliability for downstream identity matching.
lessons.cause: Human approval overrode unresolved anchor QA findings, and the anchor renders did not consistently enforce the actor specification or standardized training-portrait pose and lighting.
lessons.prevention: Generate each actor anchor square to camera with direct aligned gaze, broad soft neutral frontal light, and every approved age, facial, eye, hair, eyebrow, and grooming trait explicitly retained.
lessons.check: Verify square frontal pose, aligned lens gaze, neutral even light, and all actor-specific identity traits before approving an anchor.

lessons.title: Explicitly place every required supporting performer in the frame
lessons.problem: Keyframes omit required companions, background ranks, or secondary participants when the prompt concentrates on the foreground lead.
lessons.cause: Models preferentially render a single salient protagonist unless every required secondary performer is named, placed, and assigned a readable role in the composition.
lessons.prevention: Name each required supporting performer, state their screen position and depth, and require their recognizable visible presence without competing with the designated foreground lead.
lessons.check: Verify every scripted companion or group is visibly present at its specified position and depth.

lessons.title: Specify unmistakable Mi-8 transport geometry
lessons.problem: Helicopters intended as Mi-8 transports render as generic or Huey-like aircraft with skids, narrow fuselages, and incorrect rotor forms.
lessons.cause: The aircraft designation alone does not sufficiently constrain the model's helicopter silhouette and landing-gear geometry.
lessons.prevention: Describe every Mi-8 as a broad-bodied transport with wheeled landing gear, twin-engine upper housing, large side door, and five-blade main rotor; explicitly forbid Huey-like skids and narrow fuselages.
lessons.check: Verify each helicopter has a broad Mi-8 silhouette, wheels, upper twin-engine housing, and no Huey-like skids.

lessons.title: Lock character-defining civilian wardrobe, hair, and hand-state details
lessons.problem: Civilian women are repeatedly substituted with generic beige veils and garments, erasing specified black dress, exposed braids, and flour-dusted working hands.
lessons.cause: The prompt did not sufficiently bind character-specific costume, hair visibility, and hand condition against the model's generic rural-woman styling. Plausible prevention; no passing fix was recorded.
lessons.prevention: Specify each visible civilian's exact garment color, garment type, hair exposure or braids, face visibility, and required hand condition; explicitly forbid substitute beige veils or face coverings.
lessons.check: Verify each named civilian retains specified clothing, visible hair, uncovered face, and required hand detail.

lessons.title: Make a narrative empty plate visually contrast with served dishes
lessons.problem: An intended empty plate is unreadable when all visible vessels appear empty or nearly empty.
lessons.cause: The prompt named the empty plate but did not establish filled neighboring dishes as a clear visual contrast. Plausible prevention; no passing fix was recorded.
lessons.prevention: Place the designated empty plate directly beneath the actor's hand and visibly fill adjacent central and side dishes with modest period-appropriate food.
lessons.check: Verify the designated plate is plainly empty and at least two neighboring vessels visibly contain food.

lessons.title: Render deployed Malyutka launchers from a geometry reference
lessons.problem: Open 9M14 Malyutka launchers become oversized vertical rockets or inaccurate missiles, and their suitcase rail, sight, control box, and wire spool disappear.
lessons.cause: The model lacks a stable association between the weapon name and its deployed suitcase-launcher configuration. Plausible prevention; no passing fix was recorded.
lessons.prevention: Use the approved 9M14 reference and specify a horizontally resting missile on an opened fibreglass suitcase rail, with separate control box, periscope sight, and visible wire spool.
lessons.check: Verify horizontal scaled missile, opened suitcase rail, correct fins and nose probe, sight, control box, and wire spool.

lessons.title: Use recognizable period backpack-radio assemblies
lessons.problem: Field-radio beats produce generic modern handheld speakers or omit the radio, antenna, handset, and scripted control interaction.
lessons.cause: Without an explicit reference and visible component layout, models default to contemporary compact communications devices rather than coherent period field-radio systems.
lessons.prevention: Use an approved 1973 Soviet-pattern backpack-radio reference; show an olive-drab pack, whip antenna from the pack, wired handset or control assembly, analog controls, and the scripted tap, hover, or dead-radio interaction.
lessons.check: Verify the radio is a coherent period backpack system with visible antenna connection and the required hand-control state.

lessons.title: Make passing aircraft shadows visibly alter the subject exposure
lessons.problem: A required reconnaissance-aircraft shadow is absent, or reads as an unrelated dark strip while the subject remains in direct dawn light.
lessons.cause: Soft moving shadows are often omitted unless their broad coverage, edge quality, and exposure change are explicitly made the central visual event.
lessons.prevention: Render a broad soft-edged aircraft shadow crossing the actor, nearby ground, and pit wall, cooling and dimming them while direct dawn illumination remains visibly brighter beyond the shadow.
lessons.check: Verify the shadow clearly covers subject and local set, with cooler dimmer exposure than the sunlit background.

lessons.title: Direct airborne guided missiles with readable period scale and trajectory
lessons.problem: An anti-tank missile becomes an oversized flaming rocket or travels opposite its specified target direction.
lessons.cause: Projectile prompts insufficiently constrain compact missile silhouette, screen direction, target relation, and the trail's position behind the moving missile.
lessons.prevention: Specify a compact period-guided missile traveling toward its named target, with its nose leading in screen direction and a restrained exhaust trail extending only behind it.
lessons.check: Verify compact missile scale, nose-to-target direction, and exhaust trail trailing behind rather than ahead.

lessons.title: Identify M3 half-tracks by their mixed wheel-and-track running gear
lessons.problem: Background M3-type half-tracks render as fully tracked APCs, losing the scripted vehicle identity.
lessons.cause: Naming a half-track without its visible front axle and rear track geometry permits generic tracked armored vehicles.
lessons.prevention: Describe every readable M3-type half-track with a wheeled front axle, open-bodied half-track silhouette, and distinct rear track unit; explicitly forbid fully tracked APC geometry.
lessons.check: Verify each readable convoy lead vehicle has front wheels and rear tracks, not continuous tracks.

lessons.title: Render salt-marsh tanker coveralls as mud- and salt-caked one-piece garments
lessons.problem: Tank crew clothing appears as clean dry shirts or olive garments instead of heavily contaminated period coveralls.
lessons.cause: Wet sand, salt residue, embedded grit, and one-piece coverall construction are lost when uniform condition is not individually specified.
lessons.prevention: Dress visible tank crew in period olive one-piece coveralls heavily caked with wet sand, black mud, pale salt residue, and crease-embedded grit.
lessons.check: Verify one-piece coveralls and dense wet-sand, mud, salt, and crease-level contamination on every visible crewman.

lessons.title: Do not override unresolved failures of a keyframe's essential tableau
lessons.problem: Human approval accepts frames that omit the scripted setting, required ensemble, core action, or intended composition despite unresolved major review findings.
lessons.cause: Review approval is being based on general image appeal rather than hard verification of the shot's non-negotiable narrative constraints.
lessons.prevention: Before generation, mark the shot's required action, setting, cast count, prop tableau, and framing as non-negotiable reject criteria in the review brief.
lessons.check: Reject any frame missing a marked required tableau element, even if faces, lighting, or general image quality are appealing.

lessons.title: Keep the triggering threat visible behind reactive portrait performances
lessons.problem: Portrait reaction shots omit the convoy or tank that motivates the actor's signal, alarm, or attention.
lessons.cause: Shallow-focus portrait prompting prioritizes the face and lets the causal background event disappear; unresolved failures indicate the prevention is inferred.
lessons.prevention: Place the named convoy or armored threat in the soft background at a readable scale, behind and clear of the reacting actor, while preserving the specified portrait framing.
lessons.check: Verify the background contains the named triggering threat and that its vehicle type and relationship to the actor remain readable.

lessons.title: Render Sho't Kal columns with decisive Centurion identification
lessons.problem: Israeli tank columns drift into generic tracked vehicles, APCs, or tanks lacking the required Centurion skirts and fume-extractor gun.
lessons.cause: Vehicle prompts do not make the few externally readable Sho't Kal identifiers non-negotiable at the intended shot distance; unresolved failures indicate the prevention is inferred.
lessons.prevention: Use the approved Sho't Kal reference and require every readable tank to show Centurion side skirts and a proportionate 105 mm gun with prominent fume extractor; forbid turretless APC substitutions.
lessons.check: Verify each readable tank has side skirts, a turret, and a 105 mm gun with visible fume extractor.

lessons.title: Use low period roadside barriers and non-text tactical markings
lessons.problem: Desert-road imagery substitutes tall modern security fencing and readable alphanumeric vehicle markings for the designed low wire and non-text markings.
lessons.cause: Generic military-road generation introduces contemporary perimeter infrastructure and legible symbols; unresolved failures indicate the prevention is inferred.
lessons.prevention: Specify low barbed wire on short simple pickets and use only simple non-text tactical chevrons on visible vehicles; explicitly forbid tall security fences and readable letters.
lessons.check: Verify fencing stays low on short pickets and all visible vehicle markings are non-text chevrons, not letters or words.

lessons.title: Stage RPG firing frames with a clear rear danger zone
lessons.problem: RPG firing images can show a loaded rocket during backblast or place supporting soldiers directly behind the rear venturi.
lessons.cause: Unresolved; the firing phase, projectile state, and rear clearance were not made explicit as one synchronized physical tableau.
lessons.prevention: For an RPG firing instant, show the PG-7V clear of the muzzle as backblast erupts and keep every person completely lateral to the rear venturi danger cone.
lessons.check: Rocket is leaving or clear of the tube, backblast originates at the rear, and no person occupies the rear cone.

lessons.title: Anchor fighting-pit portraits to the pit wall and localized backblast
lessons.problem: Portraits intended at a fighting-pit line read as open desert because the nearby sand wall and interacting RPG dust are absent.
lessons.cause: Unresolved; the environmental anchor behind the performer was treated as optional atmosphere rather than required scene geography.
lessons.prevention: Place the performer directly beside a low pit-line sand wall and show localized RPG dust or backblast curling against that wall behind them.
lessons.check: A nearby low sand wall is visible, and dust/backblast is localized to it rather than generic distant smoke.

lessons.title: Preserve the coverless flat-desert battlefield ground plane
lessons.problem: Battlefield shots introduce rocks, scrub, berms, trenches, or clumped terrain where the setting requires flat, coverless sand.
lessons.cause: Unresolved; generic desert terrain generation overrides the location's deliberately minimal ground specification.
lessons.prevention: Render LOC-0004 as uninterrupted level wind-rippled sand with no rocks, scrub, berms, trenches, or cover except explicitly scripted shallow fighting pits and road.
lessons.check: Ground is flat and coverless; no unscripted rocks, vegetation, earthworks, or elevated cover appear.

lessons.title: Limit escaping Sho't Kal crews to four identifiable tankers
lessons.problem: Tank escape shots show too many personnel or dress them as infantry rather than the four-person vehicle crew.
lessons.cause: Unresolved; crew count and tanker-specific wardrobe were not constrained before generating the evacuation tableau.
lessons.prevention: Show exactly four escaping Sho't Kal crewmen in olive tanker coveralls and padded headset helmets, emerging from hatches or running into smoke without infantry packs or webbing.
lessons.check: Exactly four figures read as tank crew, with tanker coveralls and padded headset helmets rather than infantry equipment.

lessons.title: Specify full-length FN FAL geometry for readable Israeli rifles
lessons.problem: Israeli infantry rifles can collapse into short AR/M16-like or generic weapon silhouettes instead of full-length FN FALs.
lessons.cause: Unresolved; the weapon was named without enough visible silhouette and component constraints for distant battlefield generation.
lessons.prevention: For every readable Israeli rifle, require a full-length 1973 FN FAL silhouette with fixed stock, long barrel, receiver, magazine, and handguard; forbid AR/M16 profiles.
lessons.check: Each readable rifle has the long fixed-stock FN FAL profile, not a short AR/M16 or generic carbine.

lessons.title: Stage armored defensive formations as readable geometric dispositions
lessons.problem: Multi-tank arrangements lose their intended U-shaped defensive geometry and shared aiming direction.
lessons.cause: Prompts name a formation concept without assigning each vehicle a distinct position, orientation, and common firing sector.
lessons.prevention: Arrange every tank around three sides of a broad U, leave its open side facing the named desert sector, and turn every turret and gun toward that same open sector.
lessons.check: Verify a readable three-sided U, clear open desert side, and no friendly tanks targeted across the road.

lessons.title: Keep fighting-pit portraits visibly enclosed by the position
lessons.problem: Portraits scripted inside fighting pits render as exposed open-desert shots without a rim, wall, or falling dust.
lessons.cause: Portrait prompts prioritize face and background while omitting the nearby physical evidence that establishes below-grade shelter.
lessons.prevention: Frame the performer visibly below a shallow fighting-pit rim with a close compacted sand wall beside or behind them and fine dust actively falling from it.
lessons.check: Verify a readable pit edge or wall, below-rim placement, and falling dust near the performer.

lessons.title: Render sand fighting-pit walls with irregular natural granular structure
lessons.problem: Compacted sand walls develop repeated embossed, woven, or footprint-like generated patterns.
lessons.cause: Texture generation over-regularizes close sandy surfaces instead of producing varied granular strata and collapse detail.
lessons.prevention: Render pit walls as irregular compacted granular sand with uneven strata, small collapses, loose grains, and nonrepeating surface variation; forbid woven, stamped, or embossed motifs.
lessons.check: Verify sand texture is irregular and granular, with no repeating textile, tread, or stamped pattern.

lessons.title: Show empty AKM magazines with a visible follower
lessons.problem: Empty AKM magazine inserts render as implausibly deep hollow openings without internal follower geometry.
lessons.cause: The empty-state instruction removes cartridges but fails to specify the remaining functional magazine component.
lessons.prevention: For an empty AKM steel magazine insert, show the follower seated immediately below the feed lips with no cartridges visible.
lessons.check: Verify the magazine is cartridge-free and its follower is visible directly beneath the feed lips.

lessons.title: Render RKG-3 grenades from their distinctive long-handled geometry
lessons.problem: RKG-3 anti-tank grenades deform into bulbous or conventional hand-grenade shapes.
lessons.cause: The prop is requested by name without its diagnostic cylindrical warhead, single handle, and safety-hardware silhouette.
lessons.prevention: Use the approved RKG-3 reference and show an olive-drab straight cylindrical warhead with flat base, correct collar and safety hardware, and one long handle.
lessons.check: Verify one long handle and a straight cylindrical warhead, not a bulbous or conventional grenade silhouette.

lessons.title: Preserve deliberately empty tactical ground
lessons.problem: Wide battlefield frames gain unscripted soldiers, crewmen, or posed walkers, defeating beats built around abandonment, waiting, or nobody returning.
lessons.cause: Generation models tend to populate military landscapes unless empty zones and any permitted figures are explicitly constrained.
lessons.prevention: State that the named ground corridor is completely empty of personnel, forbid approaching or walking figures, and specify that any permitted crew remain still and visually subordinate.
lessons.check: Verify the required ground between positions is empty and no visible figure implies movement or approach.

lessons.title: Carry RPG rounds in a readable period canvas carrier
lessons.problem: Loose rockets or shells strapped upright to a soldier's back replace the required RPG ammunition carrier bag.
lessons.cause: Without an explicit carry configuration, models expose ammunition as a generic strapped projectile rather than contained equipment.
lessons.prevention: Show RPG ammunition only inside a naturally back-secured 1973 Soviet-pattern canvas rocket carrier bag, with no loose rocket, shell, or upright projectile visible externally.
lessons.check: Verify a canvas carrier bag is visible and no exposed projectile is strapped to the performer.

lessons.title: Lock the opening state to the clip's next action
lessons.problem: A keyframe specifies a state that contradicts the following motion, such as already holding a letter instead of an envelope or closed eyes before an instructed closing action.
lessons.cause: The keyframe and animation beats were authored as incompatible temporal states.
lessons.prevention: Define one continuous start-to-end prop and performance state, ensuring the opening pose leaves the exact required transition visibly possible.
lessons.check: Verify the opening state neither contradicts nor pre-completes the clip's next action.

lessons.title: Operate kerosene lamps through accessible real controls
lessons.problem: Lamp inserts show hands using chimney hardware instead of the wick wheel, or passing a match through intact glass.
lessons.cause: The lamp's functional parts and access state are not specified, allowing visually plausible but mechanically impossible interaction.
lessons.prevention: For lamp actions, name the wick-adjustment wheel and its hand grip; require the chimney lifted or removed before a match touches the exposed wick.
lessons.check: Verify fingers use the wick wheel and flame-lighting tools never intersect intact glass.

lessons.title: Make toy-airplane props unmistakable at screen scale
lessons.problem: A child's specified painted tin toy airplane renders as an ambiguous object without a readable aircraft silhouette.
lessons.cause: Small props lose their defining form unless their silhouette and handling are explicitly described.
lessons.prevention: Specify a small worn hand-painted tin airplane with a readable fuselage, two wings, and tail, held unobscured in the child's natural two-handed grip.
lessons.check: Verify the object immediately reads as a toy airplane with fuselage, wings, and tail.

lessons.title: Exclude visible bodies when fallen soldiers must remain offscreen
lessons.problem: Frames communicate battlefield loss by showing prone soldiers despite a production rule prohibiting visible corpses.
lessons.cause: Models add fallen bodies as generic battlefield dressing unless the restriction and alternate storytelling device are explicit.
lessons.prevention: Forbid all visible prone bodies and corpses; communicate losses only through abandoned equipment, empty positions, smoke, or surviving performers' reactions.
lessons.check: Verify no human body is visible lying prone or reads as a corpse anywhere in frame.

lessons.title: Preserve defining eyewear in portrait keyframes
lessons.problem: Portrait generations omit character-defining glasses, their repair detail, intended gaze, and the required practical reflection.
lessons.cause: Small transparent facial accessories and their reflections are easily deprioritized unless explicitly made visible design requirements.
lessons.prevention: Render the approved taped wire-rim glasses prominently on both eyes, face the gaze as scripted, and place controlled motivated practical reflections in both lenses.
lessons.check: Both lenses, taped hinge, scripted gaze, and restrained matching reflections are clearly visible.

lessons.title: Maintain natural child proportions in youth keyframes
lessons.problem: A child performer renders with an oversized head and childlike body scale inconsistent with the specified age.
lessons.cause: Adult proportion guidance does not reliably constrain younger performers' head-to-body scale.
lessons.prevention: Specify the child's approved age and a naturally proportioned slim youth body, with a visibly smaller head centered on the neck and shoulders proportionate to the torso.
lessons.check: The child reads as the specified age with natural head, shoulder, torso, and limb proportions.

lessons.title: Render accumulated depletion for gaunt survivor states
lessons.problem: Long-march survivors appear healthy, clean, and lightly dusty instead of visibly exhausted and worn.
lessons.cause: Default portrait beautification suppresses gauntness, cracked lips, sun exposure, grime, and cumulative wear unless these are foregrounded.
lessons.prevention: For gaunt survivor states, render sunburned hollow cheeks, cracked lips, natural grime, and heavily accumulated dust with restrained mud staining across uniform, straps, and carrier.
lessons.check: Face, lips, skin, uniform, and kit visibly show sustained exhaustion and accumulated field wear.

lessons.title: Remove combat webbing from unarmed home-leave appearances
lessons.problem: A home-leave soldier renders with ammunition webbing and combat straps despite an unarmed civilian-context beat.
lessons.cause: Military character priors retain tactical load-bearing gear unless the off-duty loadout is explicitly excluded.
lessons.prevention: For unarmed home-leave shots, forbid weapons, webbing, ammunition pouches, and double load straps; allow only the specified small plain canvas kit bag on one shoulder.
lessons.check: No tactical gear or weapon is visible; only the approved minimal personal bag is carried.

lessons.title: Block multi-person contact beats as named hand-and-body relationships
lessons.problem: Generated group reunions can substitute the wrong recipient of a gesture and omit the required attachment between supporting performers.
lessons.cause: The interaction was described as a general emotional grouping rather than as explicit, individually assigned body positions and contact relationships.
lessons.prevention: Name each actor's screen position, posture, receiving hand, touching hand, and continuous contact target; explicitly forbid every incorrect recipient or substituted embrace.
lessons.check: Verify each named hand reaches the correct actor and every required cling, bend, or supporting contact is visibly readable.

lessons.title: Define card shots as a specific graphic or still before rendering
lessons.problem: Undefined epilogue, end-credit, and title-card shots are being rendered as unrelated live-action wartime tableaux.
lessons.cause: The card content, presentation type, and any typography exception were left undefined, allowing the model to infer a generic war scene.
lessons.prevention: Specify every card's exact graphic or still-image composition, text policy, subject matter, and prohibited live-action content before generation.
lessons.check: Verify the frame is the specified card composition, not an unrelated battlefield, patrol, village, or military tableau.

lessons.title: Remove forbidden portrait remnants from poster skies
lessons.problem: Poster revisions can retain ghostly faces or facial nebulae in sky areas after a portrait element has been removed.
lessons.cause: Composite-layer removal was not treated as a full-background reconstruction requirement.
lessons.prevention: Replace the entire removed-portrait region with continuous natural sky texture matching adjacent clouds, stars, grain, and illumination; explicitly forbid faces, facial features, portrait silhouettes, seams, and face-shaped nebulosity.
lessons.check: Verify the sky contains no recognizable facial anatomy, translucent portrait, composite seam, or face-shaped cloud formation.

lessons.title: Unify horizon and scale hierarchy in split-environment posters
lessons.problem: Composite posters can create mismatched horizon lines and oversized secondary figures that disrupt the intended dominant subject.
lessons.cause: The poster composition lacked an explicitly shared horizon and quantified visual hierarchy between blended environments and secondary silhouettes.
lessons.prevention: Set one shared horizon across all blended environments and specify the sole dominant figure; render secondary figures as small silhouettes confined below that horizon.
lessons.check: Verify both environments meet on one horizon and no secondary figure rivals the designated dominant subject.
